notes.source_fact: Main save deletion precedes optional backup existence check and deletion. If main deletion succeeds, backup remains a regular file, and its deletion raises a system-call error before removal, the caller catches that error and requests the shared failure message; main is absent and backup remains. No rollback or retry is present in the two fixed definitions.
notes.ordinary_control: Both existing files deletable gives neither file; no backup gives only main deletion. Main deletion raising before removal leaves main and skips backup operation. Title confirmation cancellation never reaches delete helper.
notes.minimal_counterexample: Both files exist. User approves title deletion twice. Main deletion succeeds. Backup deletion is denied and leaves backup. Shared failure message is requested. A later ordinary SaveData.exists? sees no main file, so a residual backup is not independently sought by the constructor's no-main branch.
notes.rebuttal: UI65 section3.3 explicitly already acknowledges partial failure through shared feedback and no retry. It must not be described as claiming atomicity, full rollback, or no partial-failure coverage.
notes.remaining_gap: Current WP09/WP10/UI65 do not specify deletion order or distinguish the two concrete persistent failure prefixes and later no-main branch. Proposed correction should add those source facts, preserving existing confirmation/feedback/return flow and all saving recovery semantics.
notes.negative_evidence: All formal files searched for exact save-deletion identities/messages and bounded Chinese save-deletion/backup wording; relevant WP09/WP10 full text and UI65 delete/save sections read independently. Broad generic delete search produced truncated output and is not treated as complete negative proof.

notes.facet: Emergency-save backup message request versus actual old backup state
notes.source_fact: After successful Game.save the emergency path requests both saved and previous-file-backed-up messages regardless of whether an old file existed; actual backup copy is conditioned on old-file existence.
notes.counterevidence: UI65 section4.2 already specifies the unconditional two-message success path and conditioned copy. WP10/MG07's statement that a previous file is actually backed up only when one existed is true as a state fact. Its wording does not itself conclusively assert absence of the message request. Preserve this distinction; do not create a required root merely by reading the state-truth qualification as a UI predicate.

notes.facet: New-game save-attempt flag cleared before saving, retained false after failure
notes.source_fact: After user confirms the save/overwrite gates, the new-game flag is cleared before normal saving. A false save result does not restore that flag; a later attempt skips the different-save warning if file existence otherwise holds.
notes.counterevidence: UI65 section4.1 already explicitly says clear the flag after overwrite confirmation before continuing, and saving failure does not roll back changes in this layer. Cancellation at overwrite gate precedes clearing. A separate mandatory root for this existing covered prefix would duplicate a correct contract.
